mapper.select: SELECT FROM layout_zones WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT z.id AS zoneId, z.name AS zoneName, z.zone_type AS zoneType, l.id AS layoutId, l.title AS layoutTitle, z.layout_version_id AS layoutVersionId, z.default_exit_id AS defaultExitId, de.name AS defaultExitName FROM layout_zones z JOIN layouts l ON l.current_version_id = z.layout_version_id LEFT JOIN layout_exits de ON de.id = z.default_exit_id WHERE z.assigned_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.id ASC, z.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO layout_zones (layout_version_id, name, zone_type, x, y, width, height, assigned_user_id, default_exit_id, display_order) VALUES (#{layoutVersionId}, #{name}, #{zoneType}, #{x}, #{y}, #{width}, #{height}, #{assignedUserId}, #{defaultExitId}, COALESCE(#{displayOrder}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE layout_zones SET name = #{name}, zone_type = #{zoneType}, x = #{x}, y = #{y}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, assigned_user_id = #{assignedUserId}, default_exit_id = #{defaultExitId}, display_order = COALESCE(#{displayOrder}, 0) WHERE id = #{id} AND layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId}
